explanation: The Lomb-Scargle floor leaves CircadianTab for lombScargleFloor.ts: armLombScargleFloor owns its preconditions (method, finished scan of the arm, scored rows), the per-pattern cap check and the observed-p guard, and returns LombScargleBound or null, which CircadianNotes now takes instead of the nPerArm / NaN lsCeiling pair. rhythmCall.ts holds the rhythmic call (rhythmScore, isRhythmic) and the per-arm verdict (armVerdict), read by the tab, the results table (its scoreOf prop is gone) and ArmStatsStrip. rhythmicity.ts, jtkCycle.ts and distributions.ts are byte-unchanged and still match the retained validation hashes; scan.ts is untouched.
